SHIP TLS certificate identity and fingerprint pinning, explicit pairing, handshake ordering and live revocation

Local 0600 SHIP identity storage, validated key pair and fail-closed corrupt identity recovery

Functional module configuration, discovery, pairing and admin navigation UI
Automatic eligible legacy handover retains eebus.N datapoint IDs, validated SHIP identity and existing verified certificate pins; unavailable protected fields or unpinned peers block before cutover
Private in-process bridge retains EOS authority while routing preserved legacy EEBus/UI namespaces
Manual configuration-only import remains disabled and requires fresh pairing
supportStatus: Integrated SHIP/SPINE field-test core; physical-device interoperability and certification remain unverified
